text: Air traffic controllers have begun a walkout in Norway after mediation talks on working conditions failed to reach an agreement, with 12 controllers striking at Oslo Gardermoen and Bergen Flesland. The action is expected to cause delays and disruptions across the country through
translated_text: 在有关工作条件的调解谈判未能达成协议后，挪威空中交通管制员开始罢工，奥斯陆加勒穆恩和卑尔根弗莱斯兰有 12 名管制员罢工。预计这一行动将在全国范围内造成延误和干扰

text: A report by U.S. think tank The Soufan Centre says Afghanistan remains a safe haven for terrorist groups and violent extremist elements under Taliban rule, with the country facing continued economic decline and international isolation.#Afghanistan#Terrorism#Taliban
translated_text: 美国智库苏凡中心的一份报告称，阿富汗在塔利班统治下仍然是恐怖组织和暴力极端分子的避风港，该国面临持续的经济衰退和国际孤立。#阿富汗#恐怖主义#塔利班

text: BNP Secretary-General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected Bangladesh’s 23rd president, securing 255 votes against 88 for opposition candidate Oli Ahmad in the country’s first contested presidential election in 35 years.#Bangladesh#MirzaFakhrulIslamAlamgir
translated_text: BNP 秘书长米尔扎·法赫鲁尔·伊斯兰·阿拉姆吉尔 (Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir) 当选孟加拉国第 23 任总统，以 255 票对反对派候选人奥利·艾哈迈德 (Oli Ahmad) 的 88 票当选，这是该国 35 年来首次有争议的总统选举。#Bangladesh#MirzaFakhrulIslamAlamgir

text: The U.S. commission on international religious freedom has called for a ban on the Hindu extremist organisation RSS over its involvement in attacks on minorities in India.#India#RSS#ReligiousFreedom#MinorityRights#PakistanTV
translated_text: 美国国际宗教自由委员会呼吁禁止印度教极端主义组织 RSS，因为该组织参与袭击印度少数民族。#India#RSS#ReligiousFreedom#MinorityRights#PakistanTV

text: Kazakhstan is set to hold elections for its 145-member kurultai on August 23 under the country’s new constitution. With seven political parties contesting and significant youth and female participation, the proportional representation polls are expected to play a key role in
translated_text: 根据哈萨克斯坦新宪法，哈萨克斯坦将于 8 月 23 日举行由 145 名议员组成的库鲁勒台选举。由于有七个政党参与竞选，并且青年和女性参与人数众多，比例代表制民意调查预计将在选举中发挥关键作用。

text: The MOU aims to strengthen cooperation in Pakistan on digital skills, IT exports and innovation, while Google has set a target of issuing 150,000 career certificates in the country in 2026. Pakistan and Google have also agreed to expand Pakistani students’ access to advanced AI
translated_text: 该谅解备忘录旨在加强巴基斯坦在数字技能、IT 出口和创新方面的合作，而谷歌则设定了到 2026 年在该国颁发 15 万份职业证书的目标。巴基斯坦和谷歌还同意扩大巴基斯坦学生获得先进人工智能的机会

text: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif hosts a reception for a Google delegation as Pakistan and Google sign an important Memorandum of Understanding aimed at accelerating the country’s digital transformation, fostering innovation, and strengthening its technology sector.@CMShehbaz
translated_text: 巴基斯坦总理谢巴兹·谢里夫 (Shehbaz Sharif) 接待了谷歌代表团，巴基斯坦和谷歌签署了一份重要的谅解备忘录，旨在加速该国的数字化转型、促进创新和加强其技术部门。@CMShehbaz

text: Beijing-based geopolitical analyst Ayub Sumbal says, “Sanctions never work, and because the Iran economy and the way of their economic governance is totally different, it will not have any impact on the Iran economy. It’s quite a resilient economy, and it has been surviving for
translated_text: 北京地缘政治分析师阿尤布·苏姆巴尔表示：“制裁永远不会起作用，而且由于伊朗经济及其经济治理方式完全不同，因此不会对伊朗经济产生任何影响。这是一个很有弹性的经济，而且已经生存了很长时间。”

text: The body of missing US climber Sarah Mallory Geis, who went missing after being struck by an avalanche on July 30, has been found on the slopes of Broad Peak in Pakistan’s Karakoram range, Alpine Club of Pakistan President Irfan Arshad Khan has confirmed.#BroadPeak#Pakistan
translated_text: 巴基斯坦高山俱乐部主席伊尔凡·阿尔沙德·汗证实，7 月 30 日遭遇雪崩后失踪的美国登山者萨拉·马洛里·盖斯 (Sarah Mallory Geis) 的尸体在巴基斯坦喀喇昆仑山脉的布洛阿特峰山坡上被发现。#BroadPeak#Pakistan

text: Pakistani mountaineer Asma Mushtaq lost her life during the descent from 7,027-metre-high peak Spantik, after suffering a serious high-altitude illness at approximately 6,400 metres, the Alpine Club of Pakistan said.#Pakistan#AsmaMushtaq#Spantik#Mountaineering#PakistanTV
translated_text: 巴基斯坦阿尔卑斯山俱乐部表示，巴基斯坦登山家阿斯玛·穆什塔克 (Asma Mushtaq) 在海拔约 6,400 米的高度患上严重的高海拔疾病后，在从海拔 7,027 米高的斯潘提克山 (Spantik) 下撤时丧生。#Pakistan#AsmaMushtaq#Spantik#Mountaineering#PakistanTV
